title: Policy period
text: Cover is available only for hospitalisation that begins within the policy period. Claims on a lapsed or expired policy are not admissible.

title: Room rent limit and proportionate deduction
text: If the insured occupies a room above the eligible room rent limit, associated medical expenses (room, surgeon, OT, nursing) are payable in the same proportion as eligible rent to actual rent. Pharmacy, consumables, implants and diagnostics are not proportionately reduced.

title: Co-payment
text: A co-payment, where specified in the schedule, is borne by the insured on every admissible claim after all other limits are applied.

title: Sub-limits
text: Specified procedures are payable up to the sub-limit stated in the policy schedule, irrespective of the actual cost.

title: Initial waiting period
text: Expenses for any illness contracted within 30 days of first policy inception are excluded, except claims arising from an accident.

title: Specific waiting period
text: Listed conditions and procedures are covered only after the specific waiting period stated in the schedule has been served continuously.

title: Pre-existing diseases (PED)
text: Any condition diagnosed or treated within 48 months before inception is a PED and is covered only after the PED waiting period. Non-disclosure of a material PED may lead to repudiation after investigation.

title: Cosmetic and aesthetic treatment
text: Treatment to change appearance, unless needed for reconstruction after an accident, burn or cancer, or to restore a bodily function, is excluded.

title: Dental treatment
text: Dental treatment is excluded unless it requires hospitalisation due to an accident.

title: Documents for cashless authorisation
text: The hospital must submit the pre-authorisation form, insured ID card, treating doctor's notes and supporting investigation reports. Accident cases additionally need an MLC or FIR copy.

title: Reasonable and customary charges
text: Charges are payable only to the extent they are reasonable and customary for the procedure in that geography, as per the agreed network tariff.
